subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this one-tick flush defer as the session-state fix?
rationale: The source boundary and focused tests line up with the reported failure, but the PR is external and the affected behavior is a production timing race in session history rather than only a unit-level helper path.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output or comparable OpenClaw runner logs showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source/test proof risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on the focused helper diff and tests while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101850 until someone can produce the needed real-run evidence.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
